caveats: ESM-2 LLR is a self-supervised conservation/compatability score, not a clinical predictor; it does not read mechanism (a hypomorph can score mild).
Masked-marginal (single-mask) scoring approximates the variant marginal; wild-type-marginal scoring is a possible refinement not run here.
Stop-gains cannot be scored directly (no '*' in the ESM vocabulary); the nonsense calibration rows use the 'X' unknown-aa token and measure loss-of-wildtype only.
gnomAD common missense are a benign-ENRICHED proxy, not confirmed benign; ultra-rare are deleterious-enriched, not confirmed pathogenic.
The query variant itself appears in gnomAD r4 with AC=1 in exomes; it is excluded from the percentile background.
MANE-consistent numbering verified against UniProt O60566 (pos737=L, pos1002=N).
